candidates.title: Prepare a restaurant new-order alert

demandEvidence.chore: Notify a restaurant when a web order arrives.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .

ease.reason: A beginner can test an operator-entered sample order and format an alert; the request names Make.com but documents no trigger or delivery setup.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a small restaurant might pay for order alerts; this request establishes neither willingness to pay nor a validated buyer.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can turn supplied sample order fields into an alert; live website access and WhatsApp delivery remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed workflow could format each supplied order, but no source documents an automatic trigger or delivery; a person must verify and send alerts.

evidence.reason: The discussion states an intent to build restaurant order notifications, but gives no frequency, required fields, trigger details, or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: assess a bounded prototype that formats operator-supplied or synthetic order details into an alert. The source does not establish automatic website triggering or WhatsApp delivery, so the live workflow is unsupported.
